rule: UNGA Resolution A/RES/81/8 adopted 29-Oct-2026 extends Bangladesh preparatory period until 24-Nov-2029.
research_implication: Use 24-Nov-2029 as current UN graduation date; do not model 2026 graduation as current baseline.

rule: Regulation (EU) 2026/1395 published 22-Jun-2026; applies from 1-Jan-2027 for 10 years.
research_implication: Future EU tariff scenarios must be based on 2026 regulation, not only Regulation 978/2012.

rule: Article 18 suspends Common Customs Tariff duties on all products in CN Chapters 1–97 except Chapter 93 for EBA-origin goods.
research_implication: Current EBA baseline is zero duty (subject to origin/administrative requirements).

rule: Article 17(2) authorises removal from EBA after a three-year transition from date country ceases to fulfil LDC condition.
research_implication: After 24-Nov-2029, transition could run roughly to late-Nov-2032; exact effective date depends on Commission delegated act.
validation: Confirmed rule; implementation date not yet fixed

rule: Article 7(2): ad valorem duties for S-11a/S-11b textiles are reduced by 20% (relative reduction) from MFN; specific duty treatment differs.
research_implication: Do not treat as 20 percentage points; line-specific MFN rates and exceptions must be extracted.
validation: Confirmed rule; tariff-line rates not yet extracted

rule: Article 12: ad valorem Common Customs Tariff duties on products listed in Annexes III and VII, originating in GSP+ country, are suspended.
research_implication: GSP+ can be a zero-ad-valorem scenario, but Bangladesh eligibility cannot be assumed; requirements include conventions, monitoring and effective implementation.
validation: Rule confirmed; Bangladesh eligibility not assessed

rule: Annex III GSP Section S-11b includes Chapters 61, 62 and 63; Chapter 61 knitted apparel, Ch.62 non-knitted apparel, Ch.63 other made-up textile articles.
research_implication: The statutory safeguard denominator includes Chapter 63; a model using only Chapters 61–62 is incomplete.

rule: For S-11b, Article 33 threshold is 37% of EU imports of S-11b products from all GSP beneficiary countries; if exceeded for a beneficiary, tariff preferences under Arts.7 and 12 can be removed by annual implementing act.
research_implication: Need annual trade values from all GSP beneficiary countries for all S-11b products; the threshold cannot be tested with the global-share data in the HS6 sample.
validation: Confirmed legal rule; Bangladesh test not calculated

rule: Article 33(2) excludes EBA beneficiaries and countries whose share of total EU imports of the relevant products does not exceed 6%.
research_implication: Bangladesh is currently protected by EBA exemption; after EBA exit the 6% test must be calculated for all of S-11b.
validation: Confirmed legal rule; Bangladesh test not calculated

rule: GSP uses EU rules of origin in Regulations 2015/2446 and 2015/2447; group III regional cumulation includes Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.
research_implication: Rules of origin are material; preference utilisation is not equivalent to eligibility. Need product-specific origin rules.
validation: Confirmed common rules; product rule mapping pending
